topic: How does defocused reflector gain loss impact link budget margins for SNR compared to conventional designs?
response: Defocused reflector gain loss is 1.52 dB at 0° and 1.70 dB at 3.56°, impacting link budget margins for SNR. Conventional designs suffer more, with up to 6 dB loss, affecting system reliability and performance.
reference_context: Defocused reflector concept reduces gain loss due to feed failures, with 1.52 dB loss at 0°, compared to conventional reflectors with up to 6 dB loss.
